name: Pineapple Shake
steps: Use drained canned pineapple, or simmer fresh peeled pineapple pieces in a little water for 5 minutes and cool completely. Heating prevents fresh pineapple enzymes from turning a stored milkshake bitter.
Drain excess liquid and chill the pineapple and milk before blending.
Blend pineapple with about 180 ml milk until smooth, then add the remaining milk, sugar and vanilla.
Blend briefly until frothy; taste before adding more sugar because canned fruit may already be sweetened.
Divide into four glasses and serve immediately. Do not blend hot fruit with cold dairy.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
